title: Mean time to detect — cloud misconfiguration (MTTD)
summary: Time between the earliest cloud-control-plane evidence that a posture deviation exists (OCSF Compliance Finding 2003) and the moment the cloud_misconfiguration playbook ingests it. Lower is better. Anchored on ENISA cloud-security guidance and on NIS2 Article 21(2)(e) which obliges operators to maintain a documented vulnerability-handling surface — posture deviations are the cloud-native analogue.

target.rationale: ENISA good-practice baseline for posture-finding ingestion latency.

measurement.formula: p95( playbook.ingest_finding.started_at - telemetry.compliance_finding.time ) over confirmed posture findings in window.

inputs.name: first_event
inputs.description: earliest OCSF Compliance Finding event time for the deviation

inputs.name: ingest_started
inputs.description: start time of the playbook's ingest-finding step

external_refs.name: DORA Regulation (EU) 2022/2554, Article 9 — protection and prevention
